## How to use

Use the exact recorded prompt. No reference image is required. Changes to the prompt or inputs create an untested variant.

## Observed result

Orange koi seen from above in pale blue water with light caustics; tail slightly cropped at left. Generated with the exact short source prompt.

## Source and generation

Exact short prompt transcribed from the official demonstration. [Source](https://openai.com/index/introducing-images-2-6/#more-ways-to-create-and-edit-in-the-api). Source-post engagement does not measure this newly generated example.

Produced with the built-in GPT Image tool. The tool did not return an exact provider model ID; GPT Image 2.6 is the research topic, not a verified version claim for this output. All reference images used here were generated for this project.
